description: This Java source file defines an Android activity called 'Signature' that manages capturing a signature as well as taking and uploading parcel images, then updating related database entries in a transportation management Android application.

classes.name: Signature
classes.description: Android activity handling capturing signature drawings, taking photos, uploading images, and updating database records related to parcels and delivery jobs.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and configures event listeners for buttons and views.

methods.name: createImageFromSignature
methods.description: Captures the drawn signature as a Bitmap and triggers image upload.

methods.name: takePicture
methods.description: Starts camera intent to capture a photo and saves it temporarily.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from camera activity, retrieves and displays the captured image.

methods.name: uploadBitmap
methods.description: Uploads a Bitmap image to a server via a custom Volley request and processes the response.

methods.name: getFileDataFromDrawable
methods.description: Converts a Bitmap into a byte array for upload.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted as specified.

methods.name: updateDatabase
methods.description: Sends a PUT request to update the job record with image URLs and delivery status.

methods.name: callUpdateDatabase
methods.description: Generates image names and calls updateDatabase to update job info.

methods.name: createTemporaryFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in external storage for storing captured images.

methods.name: grabImage
methods.description: Reads the image from the camera intent's saved URI, resizes it, and displays it in ImageView.
